questions.q: The near midfielder arrives at the loose ball. Tap where the central partner should stay.
options: Beside the midfielder at the ball
questions.explain: Yes. Staying deeper, the partner can delay a counterattack if Blue reaches the next touch first.
choiceExplanations: Two midfielders on one ball leaves nobody to delay a counterattack if Blue wins it.
Joining the forwards leaves the middle empty behind the contest.

questions.q: Follow the second ball. Put these moments in order, first to last.
options: A challenged touch leaves it loose
Blue wins it, recover through the middle
questions.explain: Right. Set the depths, the ball drops loose, support arrives, then recover when Blue wins it.
choiceExplanations: Right. Set the depths, the ball drops loose, support arrives, then recover when Blue wins it.
The ball only drops loose after the forwards set their depths and contest it.
The midfielder arrives once the ball is loose, not before the challenge.
Recovering comes last, once Blue has reached the next touch first.

questions.q: True or false? Here both central midfielders arrive at the loose ball, and your team is protected against a counter.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. One midfielder must stay deeper, so a Blue counterattack meets a delaying player.
choiceExplanations: With both midfielders at the ball, nobody stays deeper to delay Blue if they win the next touch.
Right, it's false. One midfielder must stay deeper, so a Blue counterattack meets a delaying player.
